title: CORE-07 Starter Read-Only Workflow Pack Library
purpose: Deliver five read-only starter Workflow Packs (PR diff review, CI failure triage, issue triage, meeting notes action plan, release notes) composing qualified core.* capabilities, expand Task Intake labeled evaluation coverage, enhance Companion Console pack cards, and queue SEC-01 Central Execution-Policy Runtime Gate as the next planned milestone.

excluded: Side-effecting write, shell, or network tool permissions in starter packs
Runtime implementation of SEC-01 central execution-policy gate (queued as planned milestone only)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Five read-only starter Workflow Packs (pr-diff-review-pack, ci-failure-triage-pack, issue-triage-pack, meeting-notes-pack, release-notes-pack) exist under workflow-packs/ and compose qualified core.* tracks into validated structured briefs.

evidence.note: AC1 & AC4 verified all 6 official packs load with 0 load errors, validate against locaily.workflow_pack.v1, meet core.* qualification readiness, and meeting_action_plan passes core.validate.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All starter packs remain strictly read-only (only model.run permission, zero write/shell/network/credential permissions, pure in-memory tool handlers with no disk/process/network imports).

evidence.note: AC2 audited permissions.json (only model.run), tool.json (permissions: []), and tools/index.js source (no fs/child_process/http imports) across all 6 packs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All six installed Workflow Packs pass workflow-pack-sdk validate and workflow-pack-sdk test end-to-end against mock runtime with valid schemas and expected output fields.

evidence.note: AC3 ran workflow-pack-sdk validate and workflow-pack-sdk test across all 6 packs: 100% ok:true, schemaValid:true, zero missing expected fields.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Expanded Task Intake labeled evaluation dataset (>= 40 cases covering built-ins, all 6 packs, cross-pack disambiguation, ambiguity, and read-only refusals) achieves >= 90% accuracy, 100% refusal recall, and 0 invented tracks.

evidence.note: AC5 (and test:task-intake) evaluated 42/42 cases passed (accuracy=100.0%, refusalRecall=100.0%, invented=0).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Companion Console pack cards display read-only posture badge and a one-click Load in Runner button.

evidence.note: AC6 verified live HTTP /console/app.js serves mode: read-only badge and data-pack-workflow Load in Runner button.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Central execution-policy runtime gate milestone (sec-01-execution-policy-runtime-gate) is queued as a valid planned milestone in development/milestones/ and development/roadmap.json without starting or activating it.

evidence.note: AC7 verified sec-01-execution-policy-runtime-gate exists with status='planned', startedAt=null, and is registered in development/roadmap.json.

acceptanceCriteria.description: npm run test:starter-packs, npm run test:task-intake, npm run test:workflow-packs, and full npm run test:full plus clean-server smoke checks pass 100%.

evidence.note: test:starter-packs (7/7), test:task-intake (6/6), test:workflow-packs (7/7), test:full (all 27 suites), and clean-server smoke (61/61 smoke, 8/8 jobs, 11/11 relay e2e) all passed.
